persona: Mid-level SAP PI/PO developer now building on SAP Integration Suite
resumeText:
Vikram Malhotra | Gurugram | vikram.malhotra@example.com

EXPERIENCE
SAP Integration Consultant, Aravalli Integration Services, Gurugram (2022 - present)
- Built iFlows in SAP Integration Suite to connect S/4HANA with a third-party logistics system.
- Wrote Groovy scripts to split payloads and set dynamic headers.
- Built XSLT and message mappings for IDoc to XML conversions.
- Connected REST and OData APIs using the HTTP and OData adapters.
- Migrated 40 PI/PO interfaces to Cloud Integration with the functional team.
- Monitored failed messages and fixed production integration errors.

SAP PI/PO Developer, Yamuna Infotech, Noida (2019 - 2022)
- Configured IDoc and RFC scenarios in SAP PI/PO for finance and sales interfaces.

SKILLS
SAP CPI, Groovy, XSLT, SAP BTP cockpit, SAP PI/PO

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Communication, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, 2019
